bibliographic.title: Mouse Quest Chapter 1 - The Arrival of Winter
bibliographic.author: Bryan Lian and Sean Lian
bibliographic.description: "Good morning Nibbles. The other mice are all out gathering the last of the nuts and berries," Mother Mouse informs you. She is busy in the kitchen as always. "Though I don't know how much there is left for them to find, with winter being so close. Now then, would you be a dear and go to the bush on top of our stump for some huckleberries? There ought to be one or two left, and that would be plenty."
